notes: Roster and avatar URLs were read from the rendered signed-in LWServers My alliance page on 5 September 2026.
Current means the roster displayed by LWServers at capture time; membership was not independently checked inside the game.
FSP values are rounded display estimates, not measured first-squad power. Ten entries use assumed hero power as their basis.
Membership comparisons use player IDs. Added or absent means a difference between these two sources, not a verified join or departure date.

Kills, power, hero power and last-seen labels were subsequently read from all 100 signed-in profile dialogs. Numbers are rounded screen values; a dash is stored as unavailable. These profile statistics can still be older than the displayed roster.
